title: Instagram Viral Reel Script & Hook Extractor
description: Discover Instagram reels by hashtag or profile, filter to the top performers, and extract each reel's spoken transcript so you can pull out the hook (opening line) and full script.

reelUrls.title: Reel URLs (optional)
reelUrls.description: Paste specific Instagram reel links to extract hooks/scripts from directly. Leave empty to discover reels automatically via Search terms below instead.

search.title: Search terms (hashtags or keywords)
search.description: Comma-separated hashtags/keywords to discover reels with, e.g. "indian uncle, indian aunty, desi meme". Ignored if Reel URLs above is filled in. Do not include the # symbol.
search.default: indian uncle, indian aunty, desi uncle aunty meme

searchType.title: Search type
searchType.description: How to interpret the Search terms field.

resultsType.title: Result type
resultsType.description: Type of content to pull from each search term.

resultsLimit.title: Max reels per search term
resultsLimit.description: How many reels to pull for each hashtag/profile in Search terms. Apify bills per result and Instagram may rate-limit very large pulls, so scale up gradually (e.g. test at 50-100 before requesting thousands).

onlyPostsNewerThan.title: Only posts newer than
onlyPostsNewerThan.description: Skip reels older than this. Accepts a relative value like "6 months", "30 days", or an absolute date like "2026-01-01".

minViews.title: Minimum view count filter
minViews.description: Only send reels with at least this many views into transcription, so you're not paying to transcribe low-performers. Set to 0 to disable.

minLikes.title: Minimum like count filter
minLikes.description: Only send reels with at least this many likes into transcription. Set to 0 to disable.

skipPinnedPosts.title: Skip pinned posts
skipPinnedPosts.description: Exclude posts a profile has pinned to the top of their grid (only applies to profile/username search).

includeTranscription.title: Extract transcript (hook + script)
includeTranscription.description: Transcribe each reel's spoken audio to text. The transcript's opening sentence is the "hook"; the full transcript is the "script". Turning this off returns only captions and engagement stats.

hookLengthSeconds.title: Hook length (seconds)
hookLengthSeconds.description: How many seconds from the start of the transcript to treat as the "hook" line, separate from the rest of the script.

openaiApiKey.title: OpenAI API key (for transcription)
openaiApiKey.description: Required only if Extract transcript is on and you're supplying your own key for the Whisper transcription step. Leave blank to use the actor's default (if it offers one).
